newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: DDB Needham NZ names O'Halloran general manager.
newsitem.headline: DDB Needham NZ names O'Halloran general manager.

text.p: Advertising agency DDB Needham New Zealand Ltd said on Tuesday it had promoted client service director Martin O'Halloran to general manager.
O'Halloran, who joined from DDB Melbourne eight years ago to work on the McDonald's account, will continue in his client service role while co-ordinating the resources of the agency.
Chief Executive Douglas Faudet said the appointment allowed the management team to concentrate on new roles as well as maintaining an aggressive push in new business.

"Despite a tough year for the industry, DDB has continued to perform ahead of expectations. We are aggressively chasing new business while ensuring the award-winning standards of our creative work for our current clients are maintained," he said.
